title: _In vitro_ analysis of cytotoxic T cell recruitment mediated by the DC-derived chemokine CCL17
protocol: Coat plastic channel slides with 100 µl of Fibronectin-coating solution.
Incubate coated slides for 60 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the Fibronectin-coating solution from the slides.
Wash the slides once with 1 ml PBS.
Resuspend 1-2x10^7 cells/ml in PBS for fluorochrome labeling.
Add appropriate plasma membrane permeable cell tracker to the cells: CFSE at 5 µM for 10 minutes, CMTMR at 5 µM for 10 minutes, FarRed at 5 µM for 20 minutes.
Mix cytotoxic T cells (CTL) and dendritic cells (DCs) from spleen in RPMI medium containing 2% FBS at a ratio of 4:1 to achieve a total cell number of 2x10^6/ml.
Apply 100 µl of the mixed cell suspension into the channel of the μ-slide.
Cover reservoirs loosely with supplied caps for live cell imaging.
Record time-lapse series using an inverted widefield fluorescence or confocal microscope equipped with motorized xyz-stage and a climate chamber (37°C, humidified, 5% CO2).
Capture fluorescence and phase contrast or differential interference contrast (DIC) images every minute to record cell motility and cell-cell interactions over a period of 2-3 hours.
Track 100-300 motile CTL using the Manual Tracking plugin in ImageJ (NIH).
Calculate directionality of migrating CTL before physical contact to DC.
Determine duration of cell-cell interactions (contact duration).
Analyze data with the Chemotaxis and Migration Tool Plugin (IBIDI) for ImageJ.
